title: Consumer Rights, Product Warranties & Constructive Assertiveness
objective: Menyampaikan keluhan konsumen secara tegas, sopan, dan efektif untuk menuntut pengembalian dana atau penggantian barang rusak.

theory.summary: Sebagai konsumen, Anda memiliki hak untuk mendapatkan produk yang sesuai spesifikasi dan garansi yang dijanjikan. Ketika produk rusak atau tidak sesuai, Anda perlu menyampaikan keluhan secara assertif namun profesional. Assertiveness berbeda dengan agresif—Anda tetap tegas tanpa kasar. Gunakan struktur: (1) jelaskan masalah dengan spesifik, (2) rujuk hak konsumen atau garansi, (3) nyatakan permintaan yang jelas (refund/replacement), (4) tetap tenang dan dokumentasikan semua komunikasi.
rules: Gunakan 'I am entitled to...' untuk merujuk hak konsumen: 'I am entitled to a full refund under the Consumer Protection Act' atau 'I am entitled to a replacement within the warranty period'

Gunakan 'The product is defective/faulty' untuk menjelaskan masalah: 'The product is defective and does not match the specifications stated on the box' atau 'The item is faulty and stopped working after two days'

Gunakan 'I insist on...' atau 'I must insist that...' untuk menekankan permintaan: 'I insist on speaking with a customer relations supervisor' atau 'I must insist that you process my refund immediately'
Gunakan present perfect untuk menggambarkan masalah berkelanjutan: 'I have contacted your support team three times' atau 'The issue has not been resolved despite my multiple complaints'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan: Terlalu Pasif atau Terlalu Agresif
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak learner B1 menggunakan bahasa yang terlalu lemah ('maybe you could help me?') atau terlalu agresif ('You must give me money now!'). Gunakan assertive language yang tegas namun profesional dengan struktur formal dan referensi ke hak atau garansi.
commonTrap.wrong: Can you maybe give me my money back if it's not too much trouble?
commonTrap.correct: I am entitled to a full refund as the product is defective and still under warranty. I would like to process this refund today.

vocab.meaning: rusak, cacat, tidak berfungsi dengan baik
vocab.collocation: The laptop I purchased is defective and will not turn on despite being fully charged.
As a consumer, I am entitled to a replacement under the two-year manufacturer's warranty.
This product comes with a 12-month warranty that covers all manufacturing defects.
I would like to request a full refund as the item does not match the online description.

vocab.meaning: rusak, bermasalah, tidak bekerja dengan benar
vocab.collocation: The headphones are faulty—the left speaker produces no sound at all.
The product does not match the specifications listed on your website.

vocab.meaning: meningkatkan ke level yang lebih tinggi
vocab.collocation: If this issue is not resolved today, I will need to escalate my complaint to senior management.
I insist on receiving a replacement unit since this one arrived damaged.
Under consumer protection law, I have the right to return faulty goods within 30 days.
I would like to speak with a supervisor as this matter has not been handled appropriately.

dialogue.context: Sarah membawa kembali blender yang rusak ke toko elektronik. Dia berbicara dengan customer service representative untuk meminta pengembalian dana. Blender tersebut masih dalam masa garansi 1 tahun.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Good morning. I purchased this blender three weeks ago, and it's already stopped working. The motor makes a strange noise and then shuts off completely.
lines.translation: Selamat pagi. Saya membeli blender ini tiga minggu yang lalu, dan sudah berhenti bekerja. Motornya mengeluarkan suara aneh lalu mati total.

lines.speaker: Customer Service
lines.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have your receipt and the warranty card with you?
lines.translation: Saya turut prihatin mendengarnya. Apakah Anda membawa struk dan kartu garansi?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Yes, here they are. The product is clearly defective and does not match the specifications. It should last much longer than three weeks.
lines.translation: Ya, ini dia. Produk ini jelas rusak dan tidak sesuai spesifikasi. Seharusnya bertahan lebih dari tiga minggu.

lines.speaker: Customer Service
lines.text: We can send it for repairs under warranty. It usually takes about two to three weeks.
lines.translation: Kami bisa mengirimkannya untuk perbaikan dengan garansi. Biasanya memakan waktu dua hingga tiga minggu.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: I'm not satisfied with that solution. I am entitled to a full refund or immediate replacement since the product is faulty. I've only used it a few times.
lines.translation: Saya tidak puas dengan solusi itu. Saya berhak mendapat pengembalian dana penuh atau penggantian langsung karena produknya rusak. Saya baru memakainya beberapa kali.

lines.speaker: Customer Service
lines.text: I understand your frustration, but our policy requires repair attempts first before replacement.
lines.translation: Saya memahami kekecewaan Anda, tapi kebijakan kami mengharuskan upaya perbaikan terlebih dahulu sebelum penggantian.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Under consumer protection law, I have the right to choose between repair, replacement, or refund for defective goods. I insist on speaking with a supervisor to resolve this matter today.
lines.translation: Berdasarkan hukum perlindungan konsumen, saya berhak memilih antara perbaikan, penggantian, atau pengembalian dana untuk barang rusak. Saya ingin berbicara dengan supervisor untuk menyelesaikan masalah ini hari ini.

lines.speaker: Customer Service
lines.text: Let me call the store manager for you. Please wait just a moment.
lines.translation: Biar saya panggilkan manajer toko untuk Anda. Mohon tunggu sebentar.

speakingLab.context: Anda berperan sebagai konsumen yang membeli smartphone yang ternyata baterainya cepat habis dan layarnya berkedip-kedip. Anda datang ke service center untuk menuntut penggantian. Mr. Khoirul berperan sebagai customer service representative. Praktikkan cara menyampaikan keluhan secara tegas namun sopan.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good afternoon! Welcome to TechMart Service Center. How can I assist you today?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Good afternoon. I bought this smartphone from your store two weeks ago, and it has serious problems. The battery drains within three hours, and the screen flickers constantly.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I see. That does sound problematic. Do you have the purchase receipt and warranty documentation?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, here's everything. The product is clearly defective and does not match the specifications you advertised. I am entitled to a replacement under warranty.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I understand your concern. However, we typically need to run diagnostics first, which takes 5-7 business days. Then we can determine if it needs repair or replacement.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: That's not acceptable. I've only had this phone for two weeks and it's already faulty. I insist on an immediate replacement. I cannot wait another week without a working phone.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I apologize for the inconvenience. Let me check our inventory to see if we have the same model available for immediate exchange.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Thank you. If a replacement isn't available today, I would like to escalate this complaint to your supervisor and request a full refund instead.

quiz.question: I am ___ to a full refund because the product is defective and still under warranty.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'entitled' (past participle digunakan sebagai adjective) setelah 'to be' untuk menyatakan 'berhak'. Pola: be + entitled + to + noun. 'I am entitled to a refund' berarti 'Saya berhak mendapat pengembalian dana'.

quiz.question: The laptop I purchased is ___ and will not turn on at all.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'defective' (adjective) untuk mendeskripsikan produk yang rusak atau cacat. Pola: be + defective. 'Defect' adalah noun (kerusakan), sedangkan 'defectively' adalah adverb. Dalam konteks ini kita butuh adjective untuk melengkapi 'is'.

quiz.question: I must ___ that you process my refund immediately, as I have been waiting for three weeks.
quiz.explanation: Setelah modal verb 'must', gunakan bare infinitive (verb tanpa 'to'). Pola: must + insist + that-clause. 'I must insist that...' adalah cara formal dan tegas untuk menekankan permintaan Anda sebagai konsumen.

quiz.question: The product does not match the ___ listed on your website.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'specifications' (plural noun) untuk merujuk pada detail teknis atau spesifikasi produk. Setelah article 'the' kita butuh noun. 'Specify' adalah verb, dan 'specified' adalah past participle yang biasanya digunakan sebagai adjective.

quiz.question: If this issue is not resolved today, I will need to ___ my complaint to senior management.
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'need to', gunakan bare infinitive. Pola: need + to + escalate. 'Escalate' (verb) berarti 'meningkatkan ke level lebih tinggi'. 'Escalation' adalah noun, dan 'escalated' adalah past tense/participle.
